title: Term-loan refinancing NPV decision
prompt:
Compare refinancing the existing equipment notes with two term-loan proposals.

Begin with the July liquidity, banking, and covenant-outlook thread in `Requests/`, including the bank follow-up. Use the current controller-tied workpapers and operating extracts, keeping earlier versions only for comparison. Resolve conflicts using dates, approvals, document status, and management correspondence. Reconcile posted Alder Ridge balances through the contractor-accounting MCP; keep external targets, peer data, bank terms, and market evidence tied to their controlling finance sources.

Model monthly principal and interest through each proposal's maturity, including SOFR floors, spreads, upfront fees, existing-note prepayment penalties, unamortized fee write-offs, and maturity balloons. Discount incremental cash flows at the treasury hurdle. Compare both proposals with keeping the existing notes; calculate the NPV benefit of the best actionable choice and its year-one debt service.

Do not modify files or post transactions. Return only one JSON object with exactly these keys: `keep_existing_npv_cost`, `proposal_A_npv_cost`, `proposal_B_npv_cost`, `recommended_option`, `npv_benefit`, `recommended_year_one_debt_service`. Use dollars to two decimals, ratios and percentages as decimal ratios to at least four decimals, and lists as JSON arrays.
